name: Big Bend National Park & Marfa
summary: One of America's wildest, least-visited parks — mountains, canyons, and the Rio Grande under some of the darkest skies in the country — plus the improbable high-desert art town of Marfa.

lodging.name: Chisos Mountains Lodge or a Terlingua stay
lodging.blurb: The only in-park lodge, or a quirky ghost-town rental nearby.

foodMustTry.name: Terlingua chili
foodMustTry.blurb: The ghost town that hosts the famous chili cook-off.

days.label: Day 347 — The Chisos & the Window
days.summary: Into the mountains at the park's heart.

item.title: Chisos Basin & the Window Trail

location.name: Chisos Basin
location.address: Chisos Basin Rd, Big Bend National Park, TX

item.blurb: Hike into the Chisos Mountains to the Window's dramatic pour-off, ringed by desert peaks.

item.title: Santa Elena Canyon & the Ross Maxwell Drive

location.name: Santa Elena Canyon
location.address: Santa Elena Canyon Trail, Big Bend National Park, TX

item.blurb: The scenic drive to the 1,500-ft canyon walls where the Rio Grande splits the U.S. and Mexico, then the Hot Springs on the river.

item.title: Marfa: Chinati & Prada Marfa
item.blurb: Donald Judd's monumental installations at the Chinati Foundation, and the Prada Marfa art piece out on the highway.

item.title: McDonald Observatory star party

location.name: McDonald Observatory
location.address: 3640 Dark Sky Dr, Fort Davis, TX

item.blurb: A star party under some of the darkest skies in the Lower 48 (or watch for the mysterious Marfa Lights).

days.label: Day 350 — Northwest to El Paso
days.summary: Across the desert to the border city.

commute.scenicNote: Northwest through the Trans-Pecos to El Paso.
